name: tua
description: Tua language support, LOVE development tools, and an optional editor theme and setup walkthrough.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Tua uses only its bundled language server in Restricted Mode. Trust the workspace before using custom executables or running LOVE.

scripts.check: node ../../scripts/sync-version.js --check && node ../../scripts/generate-config-schema.js --check && node scripts/check-js.js && node --test test/unit/*.test.js scripts/representative-diagnostics-compare.test.js scripts/inline-editor-replay.test.js && node scripts/syntax-grammar-check.js && node scripts/manifest-check.js && node scripts/theme-check.js && node scripts/launch-config-check.js && node scripts/ollama-completion-check.js && node scripts/activation-smoke.js

tua.server.path.description: Path to the tua executable used to launch the language server.

tua.love.command.description: Path to the LOVE executable used by Tua: Run LOVE Project and Tua: Debug LOVE Project. The default uses love on PATH and falls back to common platform installs when available.

tua.love.windowsRuntime.description: Folder of the extracted 64-bit LOVE for Windows (containing love.exe) used by Tua: Package Game to build a fused Windows game. When empty, the command asks for it.

tua.love.macosApp.description: Path to love.app used by Tua: Package Game to build a fused macOS game. When empty, /Applications/love.app is used if present, otherwise the command asks for it.

tua.trace.server.description: Controls Tua language-server trace messages. Changes apply without restarting when supported by the server.

tua.log.verbosity.description: Controls Tua language-server log verbosity. Changes apply without restarting when supported by the server.

tua.format.indentStyle.description: Indentation style for the Tua formatter. Null inherits [format].indent_style from tua.toml.

tua.format.indentWidth.description: Spaces per indentation level for the Tua formatter. Null inherits [format].indent_width from tua.toml.

tua.format.lineWidth.description: Preferred line width for the Tua formatter. Null inherits [format].line_width from tua.toml.

tua.format.quoteStyle.description: Short-string quote style for the Tua formatter. Null inherits [format].quote_style from tua.toml; long-bracket strings are never rewritten.

tua.format.lineEnding.description: Line endings written by the Tua formatter. Null inherits [format].line_ending from tua.toml.

tua.format.finalNewline.description: Whether the formatter writes a final newline. Null inherits [format].final_newline from tua.toml.

tua.diagnostics.rules.description: Enable Tua's standard code-quality lint rules. Null inherits [diagnostics].rules from tua.toml.

tua.diagnostics.missingRequires.description: Report literal require and import targets that cannot be resolved.

tua.diagnostics.selfAssignments.description: Report assignments where the target and value are the same symbol.

tua.diagnostics.undefinedVariables.description: Report undefined variables when static analysis can prove them.

tua.diagnostics.unusedLocals.description: Report unused local variables, loop bindings, and direct function declarations. Prefix an intentionally unused binding with `_` to silence it.

tua.diagnostics.unusedParameters.description: Report unused function parameters and unused `...` varargs. Prefix an intentionally unused named parameter with `_` to silence it.

tua.diagnostics.useBeforeDefinition.description: Report provable use of locals before their definition.

tua.diagnostics.duplicateParameters.description: Report duplicate function parameter names as TL4043.

tua.diagnostics.impossibleBooleanExpress.description: Report boolean expressions that can never be true.

tua.diagnostics.duplicateIfConditions.description: Report repeated if or elseif conditions.

tua.diagnostics.floatEquality.description: Report direct equality comparisons on numbers.

tua.diagnostics.constAssignments.description: Report assignments to values marked as constant.

tua.diagnostics.assignmentArity.description: Report explicit assignment target/value-count mismatches while preserving Lua multi-return tails.

tua.diagnostics.localDeclarationArity.description: Report explicit local/initializer-count mismatches while preserving Lua multi-return tails.

tua.diagnostics.unusedAssignments.description: Report assignments to locals that are never read afterwards.

tua.diagnostics.binaryOperatorTypeMismat.description: Report binary operators with statically incompatible operand types.

tua.diagnostics.uncalledLocalFunctions.description: Report local functions that are referenced but never directly called; callback uses still count as uncalled.

tua.diagnostics.maxCyclomaticComplexity.description: Report functions whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds this value; zero disables the rule.

tua.diagnostics.divideByZero.description: Report division by a nonzero or dynamic value and a literal zero denominator.

tua.diagnostics.almostSwapped.description: Report consecutive assignments that look like a failed value swap.

tua.diagnostics.mixedTables.description: Report table literals that mix sequential array entries with keyed fields.

tua.diagnostics.unknownRecordFields.description: Report writes to fields that are absent from a statically known record shape.

tua.diagnostics.inlineIgnoreMaxPerFile.description: Maximum inline diagnostic suppression comments per file; zero is unlimited.

tua.diagnostics.globals.description: Additional global names accepted by diagnostics.

tua.jit.enabled.description: Enable opt-in LuaJIT shape guidance diagnostics (TL4032-TL4034). Null inherits [jit].enabled from tua.toml.

tua.ecs.enabled.description: Enable Tua's built-in ECS module, typed APIs, and ECS diagnostics. Null inherits [ecs].enabled from tua.toml.

tua.completion.sequenceRanking.enabled.description: Enable the experimental local contextual sequence ranking lane for completion ordering. Compiler candidates remain the only returned candidates.

tua.completion.sequenceRanking.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time budget in milliseconds for contextual sequence ranking. Timeout returns the pre-sequence completion ordering.

tua.completion.sequenceRanking.maxCandid.description: Maximum number of compiler candidates sent to the contextual sequence ranking lane.

tua.completion.multiToken.enabled.description: Enable the experimental multi-token completion lane. Compiler token completions remain the primary path.

tua.completion.multiToken.advanced.description: Allow multi-token suggestions even when primary compiler completion has normal confidence. When false, suggestions only appear in low-confidence local contexts.

tua.completion.multiToken.allowModelInte.description: Explicit opt-in gate for local model-backed inline completions. When enabled, bounded source context is sent to the configured loopback Ollama server.

tua.completion.inline.enabled.description: Enable deterministic local inline completions from Tua's semantic snippets and source patterns.

tua.completion.inline.sources.semantic.description: Use Tua's unique source-only statement snippets for local inline completion.

tua.completion.inline.sources.currentFil.description: Use repeated lines from the current file for local inline completion.

tua.completion.inline.sources.statistica.description: Experimentally use the local project statistical predictor after deterministic sources abstain. This source is independently off by default and is not quality-approved.

tua.completion.ollama.endpoint.description: Loopback HTTP endpoint for local Ollama completions. Non-loopback and HTTPS endpoints are rejected.

tua.completion.ollama.model.description: Local Ollama model used for Tua fill-in-the-middle inline completions.

tua.completion.ollama.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for Ollama inline-completion requests.

tua.completion.ollama.keepAlive.description: Ollama keep_alive value used to retain the local model in memory.

tua.completion.ollama.contextTokens.description: Maximum Ollama context window requested for inline completion.

tua.completion.ollama.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens Ollama may generate for one inline completion. Tua uses at most 64 for local expressions and 512 for function bodies.

tua.completion.multiToken.maxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of validated multi-token suggestions appended to completion results.

tua.fileAssociations.description: Map glob patterns to language kinds so extra file extensions can be indexed as Lua or tua sources.

tua.ignoredPaths.description: Path patterns excluded from indexing and diagnostics.

tua.requirePathSeparator.description: Separator used when tua suggests require paths.

tua.preview.enabled.description: Enable experimental sprite-animation and state-machine previews in editor integrations.

enumDescriptions: Show all Tua editor tools as toolbar buttons.
Show Run/Stop, Debug, hot reload, and a grouped Tua Tools menu.
tua.editor.toolbarMode.description: Controls the Tua editor toolbar. Compact mode groups code and structure tools to leave room for layout toggles in the title bar.

tua.run.configurations.description: Named actions for the Tua Run button. The selected name is remembered for this workspace.

instances.description: Named LOVE processes for Run, Hot reload, or Debug, sharing one build. Arguments are passed directly to each game.

tua.runtimeInspector.enabled.description: Enable read-only local runtime inspection for new Tua development runs. Uses a temporary editor-owned shim; build and package output stay unchanged. Restart a running game after enabling.

walkthroughs.title: Set Up Tua
walkthroughs.description: Make room for your code. Choose an optional theme, toolbar layout, file icons, and hint density. Every step is optional; language tools work with your existing setup.

steps.title: Choose your editor theme
steps.description:
Indigo Carbon uses quiet panels, a lighter active tab, and four repeating colors for Tua property chains. Your current theme stays selected until you choose another.
[Use Indigo Carbon](command:tua.setup.applyTheme)
[Browse Color Themes](command:workbench.action.selectTheme)
[Restore Previous Theme](command:tua.setup.restoreTheme)

media.altText: Indigo Carbon preview: a lighter active main.tua tab, quiet borders, and blue, teal, peach, and lavender property accesses.

steps.title: Give file tabs more room
steps.description:
Move editor actions beside the Command Center, keep sidebar and panel toggles visible, and group Tua tools into a compact menu. This updates user settings across projects; workspace overrides are preserved.
[Apply Tua Layout](command:tua.setup.applyLayout)
[Restore Previous Layout](command:tua.setup.restoreLayout)

media.altText: Command Center with Run, Debug, Hot Reload, Tua Tools and layout controls above a full row of editor tabs.

completionEvents: onContext:config.window.commandCenter && config.workbench.editor.editorActionsLocation == titleBar && config.workbench.layoutControl.enabled && config.workbench.layoutControl.type == both && config.tua.editor.toolbarMode == compact

steps.title: Choose file and folder icons
steps.description:
Material Icon Theme is an optional, separate extension. The button installs it from your editor’s extension registry if needed, then selects its file icons. Product icons stay unchanged.
[Install / Use Material Icons](command:tua.setup.useMaterialIcons)
[Browse File Icon Themes](command:workbench.action.selectIconTheme)
[Restore Previous File Icons](command:tua.setup.restoreIcons)

steps.title: Shader support (optional)
steps.description:
Associate this workspace’s shader files with LÖVE Shader. This avoids duplicate checks from GLSL Lint. Highlighting is optional; validation uses LÖVE first, then glslang.
[Use LÖVE Shader Associations](command:tua.setup.applyShaders)
[Install Shader Highlighting](command:tua.setup.installShaderHighlighting)
[Restore Shader Associations](command:tua.setup.restoreShaders)
[Skip](command:tua.setup.skipShaders)

steps.title: Set your hint density
steps.description:
Choose Contextual, Full, Compact, Types Only, Parameters Only, or Off for Tua inlay hints. This choice applies to the current workspace, or your user profile when no folder is open.
[Choose Hint Density](command:tua.inlayHints.selectMode?%5Bnull%2Ctrue%5D)
[Open Tua Settings](command:tua.openSettings)
